# hetznerrobot_ssh_key (Resource)

An SSH public key stored in Robot. Its fingerprint is what server orders, the Rescue System and the Linux installation take as `authorized_keys`. Only the name can change in place; new key data replaces the key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hetznerrobot_ssh_key" "admin" {
  name = "admin"
  data = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `data` (String) Public key in OpenSSH or SSH2 format.
- `name` (String) Name of the key.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation date.
- `fingerprint` (String) MD5 fingerprint of the key (`aa:bb:…`) — its id in Robot.
- `size` (Number) Key size in bits.
- `type` (String) Key algorithm, e.g. `ED25519`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import hetznerrobot_ssh_key.admin 15:28:b0:03:95:f0:77:b3:10:56:15:6b:77:22:a5:bb
```
